_meta.description: Real Notion POST /v1/search list response (api.notion.com). The envelope is {"object":"list","results":[...],"has_more":bool,"next_cursor":str|null,"type":"page_or_database"}. This fixture captures a TWO-PAGE search used to guard the Phase-3 pagination drift (finding #36): page 1 (`response.body`) is `has_more:true` with a `next_cursor` and carries ONLY database-row pages (parent.type=="database_id"), so the reconciler's latest_page_edit() MUST follow next_cursor as start_cursor to reach the loose page; page 2 (`response.body_page2`) is `has_more:false`/`next_cursor:null` and carries the newest LOOSE page (parent.type=="workspace"). A single-call fallback response (has_more absent/false) stops after one call. Doc-derived; ids/cursors/timestamps are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://developers.notion.com/reference/post-search (list object: object=list, results[], has_more, next_cursor, type; pagination via start_cursor) + https://developers.notion.com/reference/intro#pagination
